foundation.auto_update: System Core UpdateService -> exact checked upstream SHA -> external helper -> verification -> restart/rollback
foundation.data_directory: project data/ by default; SAYURI_DATA_DIR may relocate runtime data

update_protocol.sequence: task -> ID -> change -> check -> version -> journal -> commit -> next_action

versioning_policy.rule: Every released project change increments the project version.
versioning_policy.module_versions: Each module owns an independent SemVer version.

safety.graceful_shutdown: localhost tokenized POST /api/shutdown with Kill fallback only after timeout
safety.sqlite_journal_policy: WAL on safe local storage; DELETE on OneDrive/network/removable storage
safety.destructive_git_reset_policy: rollback only to recorded before_sha when worktree is clean; otherwise automatic rollback is blocked
safety.local_http: 127.0.0.1 only; loopback client + loopback Host required
safety.update_control: separate ephemeral control token; shutdown token is not reused
safety.update_rollback: tracked code archive + SQLite snapshots; failed version DBs/sidecars removed on rollback

next_action: v0.5.0 Module Runtime & Lifecycle: implement manifests, discovery, dependency graph, permissions, migrations, controlled lifecycle, persistent state, protected API, and Cognitive capability bridge.

system_core.recovery_policy: restore context and next_action without automatic replay of arbitrary actions
system_core.health_policy: lightweight polling; SQLite quick_check only on deep diagnostics

project_updates.apply_model: external helper after graceful core shutdown
project_updates.target_policy: exact SHA checked by UpdateService; fast-forward only
project_updates.rollback: only on clean worktree; restore before_sha and SQLite snapshot; local changes block destructive rollback
project_updates.restart_gate: status=ok + project identity + expected project version
project_updates.tray: menu item «Обновления проекта» uses the same local API
